en.title: Throw The Ball
en.description: Starting with friend 1, each second the ball is passed to the friend specified by receiver. Find who holds the ball after the given number of seconds.
en.input: The first line contains n and k (2≤n≤100000, 1≤k≤10^12); the second line contains n receiver indices (each in 1..n and different from the corresponding sender).
en.output: Output the 1-based index of the friend holding the ball after k seconds.
en.explanation: A linear scan/dynamic programming solution follows directly from the rules; the examples have been checked one by one against an independently built oracle.
hints: First turn the operations or constraints in the statement into a concrete array/state transition, then analyze the boundaries.
